title: Stagehand pack UI bundle index (format 1)
description: /stagehand/ui/ui.manifest.json. manifest.ui_digest = "sha256:" + hex(sha256(exact bytes of this file)). The console serves only files listed here. The uibundle package and `pack-check --ui` apply these rules plus the cross-checks a schema cannot express (entry is listed and is text/javascript; the sum of sizes is at most 16 MiB; no path has a . or .. segment; slots agree with manifest.slots; every file's bytes match).

entry.description: In-process ES module. Default export { contract_version: 1, slots }.

sandbox_entry.description: Optional single self-contained ES module (React bundled, no chunks, no externals) for the sandboxed tier. Default export { contract_version: 1, slots: { <slot>: mount } }.
